verdict.rationale: Snowpipe is a fully managed, serverless ingestion service that auto-loads files as soon as they land in a stage without customer-run pipeline infrastructure, and Streams complement this by capturing change data for downstream processing, all managed by Snowflake. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of continuous event-based (Snowpipe Streaming/Kafka) ingestion reliability at scale and any community corroboration of the 'without running pipeline infrastructure' claim beyond docs.
